request:
镜头 s18：纪录片中引用的旧资料影像，时长 9 秒，16:9 横屏，24fps，单镜头一镜到底（只写 [Shot 1]）。
年代与画面风格（detailed_description 第一行照此英文书写）：archival 2058 broadcast news footage from a shoulder-mounted ENG camera recorded on tape: interlaced softness, faint scan lines, chroma smear on reds, clipped hot whites, crushed murky shadows, compression noise, urgent imperfect framing
该类型的纪录片默认机位：archival footage quoted inside a documentary
导演意图（自然语言）：资料影像，新闻摄像机剧烈手持晃动，有扫描线和压缩噪点。几名技术员趟着齐膝的黑水，抬着设备箱穿过半淹的机房，应急灯在闪。环境声：水声、喊叫、失真的对讲机杂音。
情绪：urgent, chaotic, desperate
建议的景别与运镜（只做一个主要运镜）：medium wide shot, violently shaking handheld news camera following them
景深与虚实：Heavy archival softness, motion blur on every movement, flashes blooming.
输入图片（按发送顺序；Subject N 对应 Picture N）：
Picture 1: the storyboard keyframe of this shot (opening frame). It shows: Archival 2058 news footage: technicians in wetsuits and helmets wade through knee-deep black water in a half-flooded underground server hall, carrying equipment cases between rows of drowned server racks; emergency lights strobe. Blocking lock: technicians wade from the background toward frame left through the black water, carrying cases; drowned server racks line both sides; emergency lights flash at the top of frame.
Picture 2: the staging area of the 2058 root-server restart operation (location reference; role: location reference). A staging area at the edge of a flooded underground root-server facility in 2058: floodlights on tripods glaring off black water that covers the floor, concrete pillars, coils of cable, open equipment cases, diving helmets and air tanks on a tarp, a temporary railing at the water's edge. Empty of people, urgent, cold.
本镜头没有台词。
现场环境声：splashing water, indistinct shouting in Mandarin, crackling radio static, a pump roaring
画面中没有字幕、文字、数字和水印；没有任何音乐和旁白；只说普通话。

Archival 2058 broadcast news footage: inside a half-flooded underground root-server hall, several technicians in wetsuits and helmets wade through knee-deep black water, hauling equipment cases between rows of drowned server racks while emergency lights strobe overhead. The camera is a violently shaking shoulder-mounted ENG camera that trails them from the background toward frame left, the image soft, scanned and noisy, the reds smearing. There is no dialogue; the clip ends on the waders pushing past the last rack into the dark at frame left, the final frame heavy with motion blur and blooming strobe light.

detailed_description:
16:9 horizontal, single clip 9.0s, 24fps, archival 2058 broadcast news footage from a shoulder-mounted ENG camera recorded on tape: interlaced softness, faint scan lines, chroma smear on reds, clipped hot whites, crushed murky shadows, compression noise, urgent imperfect framing; real documentary footage, not a movie, not CGI, unposed; no hard subtitles, no burned-in captions, no on-screen text, no logo, watermark or platform bugs.
[Shot 1] At 0.0s, medium wide shot, violently shaking handheld news camera following the technicians, starting on a medium wide shot of the rack corridor and slowly widening into a looser medium wide as it trails them toward frame left, the operator stumbling on the flooded floor so the horizon tilts and snaps back. pacing: natural speed, a single continuous take with no cut. Blocking at the start: two technicians in wetsuits and helmets in the background depth of the rack corridor, wading toward frame left with an equipment case carried between them at chest height; drowned server racks frame left and frame right, half sunk; open black water fills the foreground; the strobing emergency light at the top of frame centre-right. Start: the camera finds them through the strobe, the case tipping between the two men as the water pushes against their thighs, one man's arm flung out to the rack for balance. Middle: they drive forward step by step, knees lifting high out of the black water, the case knocking twice against a rack corner, a third technician splashing in behind them with a coiled cable over his shoulder, the camera swinging wide and then punching back in, the frame losing them for a moment against a burst of clipped white. End: the leading pair reaches the near rack at frame left and shoves the case up onto a dry ledge, water sheeting off it, the camera still shaking as it settles on their helmets and the strobe flaring across the wet metal; they hold that position, breathing hard. Mood: urgent, chaotic, desperate. Blur: heavy archival softness over the whole frame, every movement trailing motion blur, the far racks and the corridor behind dissolving into murky black, the strobe blooming into smeared red-white halos; no readable text or numbers anywhere. No character speaks any line in this shot; any human voices are indistinct, unintelligible Mandarin Chinese walla only. Hold the last frame.

overall_soundscape:
Knee-deep water splashing and dragging with each step, an equipment case knocking against metal rack frames, indistinct shouting in Mandarin from the corridor, crackling distorted radio static from a shoulder set, a pump roaring somewhere behind the walls, the buzz and tick of the strobing emergency light, hard breathing inside helmets, water dripping steadily onto metal; raw production location sound only, dry and unscored, no background music.
